item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 13/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coast of Guangdong later this afternoon. Temperatures will fall appreciably and there will be a few rain patches over the region. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with the cold front, the weather will improve with cool mornings over southern China in the following couple of days. The monsoon will be replaced by an easterly airstream in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be windy and rainy over the coast of southern China. Then another cold front will affect the region during the weekend.
